metadata.author: claude
metadata.notes: Smoke fixture: synthetic context carries an approved table_mapping + 1 seed quality_issue + field profiles. The AI must extract at least 1 pattern; we expect at least one data_quality_pattern (the canonical pattern_type vocabulary in lib/ai/canonical-patterns.ts has a `null_violation` slot the AI is steered toward by the tool description). min_pattern_count is conservative (1) because synthetic context is sparse; real projects produce 8-15 patterns per the system prompt.
